title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Requested Date of a Cancellation for Replacement by a HomeFlood Policy
content:
### Requested cancellation date — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

**Scope.** For a cancellation request the named insured signs under Replaced by Private Flood because a Tidemark HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy recorded as replacing this policy took effect, and only for such a request, the requested cancellation date follows the replacement date rule of this schedule; a request under Mortgage Paid Off or Voluntary — Not Required, and a Replaced by Private Flood request whose replacing policy is not a Tidemark HomeFlood policy recorded as replacing this policy, keeps the base rule: its effective date may not be earlier than the tier's voluntary backdate period before the date the signed request is received, and for Replaced by Private Flood it is the private policy's effective date when that is later.

**The replacing policy.** The replacing policy is the customer's HomeFlood policy in status active whose replaced NFIP policy number is this policy's number; a HomeFlood policy in any other status is not a replacing policy.

**Standard requested date.** The standard requested date is the date the request is signed.

**Replacement date rule.** The request is dated the latest of the dates the rules of this schedule give.

*Hypothetical illustration.* A request signed on a given day, with nothing else bearing on its date, is dated that same day.
